Process CPU affinity and cpuset effective CPUs; effective cpu.max/cgroup quota and ancestor limits; whether unlimited or a finite grant.
Consistent per-allowed-CPU usage/idle evidence and actual existing/pending tool reservations, if constrained CPUs differ from the host.
Exact current sample UTC, independent streak, policy bindings and resource decision; no claim from an old alive snapshot.
